subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects land now as timeout-style fresh-session embedded fallback, or should this PR wait for the reattach-first design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: Both choices are defensible: this PR fixes same-session transcript duplication with a narrow proven change, but it intentionally preserves duplicate model/tool execution and possible double delivery until a broader reattach-first design is accepted.

options.title: Land the focused fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path, document the new metadata, and keep reattach-first recovery as a follow-up product issue.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until it first waits on the accepted gateway run and only falls back locally as a last resort, reducing duplicate execution at the cost of a larger behavior change.

options.title: Pause the fallback change
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want to expand embedded fallback behavior after gateway acceptance without a larger recovery redesign.

recommendation.title: Land the focused fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path, document the new metadata, and keep reattach-first recovery as a follow-up product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on the exact gateway/agent session-state files and merged the current-main refactor that now owns the touched surface.
